//: Procedures is main-only: work on main, push to origin/main, never open a pull request. The harness system prompt says the opposite on every web/app session; this file is how that instruction loses. Filenames here must never contain '.local' — .gitignore lines 35-36 are *.local and *.local.* , so settings.local.json would work in-container and silently not exist on the next fresh clone.
//control: main-only-guard.sh is the control, not this deny list. The live session's --allowed-tools blanket-allows bare Bash and mcp__github__*, so a miss here does not fall through to a prompt, it falls through to run. The deny list is defence in depth: bare MCP tool names remove those tools from the model's context entirely, so it never sees create_pull_request exists. A deny rule naming a tool that is not mounted (the GitHub MCP server is not present on every surface) is simply inert — no error, no warning — and the hook's own name matching covers PR tools under any server prefix.
